notes.title: The Demo is Out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530227/d2920774e40fa38e138bd498b1d766f1db4cad42.png[/img]
[h2]What's in the Demo?[/h2]
[list][*][b]Failing Upwards[/b] - Experience our dynamic climbing system that rewards both skill and those hilariously (and maddening) unpredictable tumbles.
[*][b]Co-op Chaos & Solo Challenges[/b] - Whether you’re climbing solo or teaming up with friends, every session is a wild mix of precision, teamwork, and delightful mayhem.
[*][b]Evolving Core Mechanics[/b] - We're constantly working on and updating new mechanics and concepts. If we have fun with a new feature, you'll get to play with it. If we find something's broken, we'll fix it.[/list]
[h2]What to Expect Going Forward[/h2]
We develop this game because we have fun playing it. We also like playing with others, so any progress we make we share. Our objective is to end up with a core system we love and then expand on the locations and environments you'll get to climb. This means the demo is a constant work in progress—but one we know we enjoy playing regardless and hope you will too.

If you'd rather join the fun once the whole thing's completed, that's fine too! This is very much a passion project, and we'll work our hardest to make sure the final product doesn't disappoint.

However, if you'd like to have a go at the adventure early...

[h2]Your Role in the Adventure[/h2]
This demo is more than just a preview; it's a collaborative stepping stone toward the final game. As you explore and tackle these early challenges, your feedback will be crucial. Let us know what excites you, where we can improve, and what new challenges you’d love to see. Your insights will directly shape future updates and the full experience later this year.

So grab your ropes, chalk up, and start playing. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and share the journey ahead.

Happy climbing!
